type: logical fake-quant quality: larger samples + paired per-example bootstrap CIs (NOT a physical serving benchmark)
question: Are the canonical quality deltas (bf16 vs rabit2; in particular HotpotQA 60.6 -> 55.2 F1) statistically robust, or within noise given the current small sample counts (8/10/15/20/24)?
plan_hypothesis_reported_not_presupposed: with paired per-example CIs and larger N, the core directional findings (small PPL degradation; larger HotpotQA regression) hold, and the HotpotQA delta's CI excludes zero

purpose_separation.addresses: SAMPLING uncertainty of the reported bf16-vs-rabit2 quality deltas: more independent units and a paired example / window bootstrap CI on each delta
purpose_separation.does_not_address: run-to-run generation variability of identical configs (fresh-GPU non-bit-exact greedy decoding) -- quantified by the control reproducibility audit and handled for validity by the frozen QA control gate; the bootstrap is conditional on this run's generations and never used to smooth or hide control instability
purpose_separation.treatment_vs_control: the paired bootstrap CI is on the within-run rabit2 - bf16 delta on identical units; run-to-run variability is an additional, unmodelled component

frontier_methods: not run (the plan marks them optional; smallest design answering the question)

scope.multilingual_ppl: not included: the plan's question names the canonical counts 8/10/15/20/24 (the five Exp1 benchmarks); multilingual PPL (Exp2) is out of scope here

code: the unchanged canonical benchmarks/quality/*.py; only CLI sample-count / NIAH-depth arguments differ; per-example logging already exists in all five scripts

common.seed: torch.manual_seed(0) and torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(0) in every script

gpu_note: scripts request gpu='H100'; Modal has previously assigned an H200 for some runs -- the GPU of each run is recorded from its log

continuation_ppl.unit: independent consecutive 1152-token WikiText-2 window (1024 context + 128 scored)
continuation_ppl.rule: the first 32 x (1024 + 128) tokens of the tokenized WikiText-2 test stream, split into consecutive non-overlapping windows; windows 1-8 are the canonical windows

niah.expansion: denser depth grid 0.05..0.95 step 0.05 (19 depths) x the same 3 context lengths
niah.rule: every (context length, depth) pair; needle at round(filler x depth); the 15 canonical cases are the depths 0.10 / 0.25 / 0.50 / 0.75 / 0.90
niah.independence_caveat: cases share the same needle and WikiText-2 filler; denser depths are not fully independent draws -- the CI is descriptive of this case set

passage_retrieval.expansion: the full pinned pool (200 rows); canonical = rows [0, 10)
passage_retrieval.rule: dataset rows [0, 200) of passage_retrieval_en @ 915b0c6 (test split), no filter

hotpotqa.expansion: the full 8k+ bucket (100 examples; dataset rows 200-299); canonical = filtered [0, 20)
hotpotqa.rule: filtered positions [0, 100) of hotpotqa_e @ 92b6c5f (test split) with length >= 8000

qasper.expansion: none possible: the 8k+ bucket has exactly 24 examples and the canonical slice is the full bucket (the plan: use the full available 8k+ bucket)
qasper.rule: filtered positions [0, 24) of qasper_e @ 52edb9d (test split) with length >= 8000 -- identical to canonical

continuation_ppl.dataset: WikiText-2 test (raw text: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pytorch/examples/main/word_language_model/data/wikitext-2/test.txt), non-empty stripped lines joined in blocks of 64
continuation_ppl.selection: deterministic: the first samples x (context + eval) tokens of the tokenized stream, split into consecutive non-overlapping spans
continuation_ppl.procedure: teacher-forced: prefill the 1024-token context, quantize/dequantize its KV once, score the 128 continuation tokens (first logit from the prefill)
continuation_ppl.metric: PPL (exp of mean token cross-entropy) and PPL delta % vs bf16

niah.dataset: synthetic needle-in-a-haystack: WikiText-2 test as distractor filler; needle 'The hidden secret code is RABIT-7291'
niah.selection: deterministic: every (context length, depth) pair; needle inserted at round(filler x depth)
niah.quantized_prefix_tokens: prompt length - 1 (the last prompt token is fed at the first decode step)
niah.metric: exact-match accuracy: regex RABIT-\d{4} on the decoded answer equals RABIT-7291
niah.warmup: one BF16 warm-up case at 4096 tokens, not reported

passage_retrieval.truncation: if longer, keep the first 8192 and last 8192 tokens
passage_retrieval.prompt: LongBench official template via the tokenizer chat template
passage_retrieval.metric: LongBench official retrieval score (fraction of numbers in the prediction equal to the target paragraph id), mean x 100

hotpotqa.selection: deterministic: examples with length >= 8000 (bucket 8k+), filtered positions [0, 20)
hotpotqa.truncation: if longer, keep the first 8192 and last 8192 tokens
hotpotqa.prompt: LongBench official template via the tokenizer chat template
hotpotqa.metric: LongBench qa_f1_score (max over reference answers), mean x 100

qasper.selection: deterministic: examples with length >= 8000 (bucket 8k+), filtered positions [0, 24)
qasper.truncation: if longer, keep the first 8192 and last 8192 tokens
qasper.prompt: LongBench official template via the tokenizer chat template
qasper.metric: LongBench qa_f1_score (max over reference answers), mean x 100

statistical_procedure.index_draw: int(rng.random() * n) with rng = random.Random(base_seed + offset) (Mersenne Twister)
statistical_procedure.percentiles: sorted replicate deltas; lower = s[floor(0.025*B)], upper = s[ceil(0.975*B) - 1]
statistical_procedure.paired: each replicate resamples unit indices once and applies them to both bf16 and rabit2

statistic.qa_retrieval_niah: 100 * (mean rabit2 unit score - mean bf16 unit score)

statistical_procedure.inputs: per-example values as logged by the canonical scripts (F1 / retrieval score 3 decimals, PASS/FAIL, per-window PPL 4 decimals); no re-generation
robustness_descriptive: per-unit delta distribution (min / q25 / median / q75 / max / mean)
share of the aggregate delta explained by the top-1 and top-3 units by |contribution| (and share of total |contribution|)
statistical_procedure.interpretation: report the delta, its CI and N; a CI containing 0 is not evidence of no effect; descriptive, cautious wording; QA deltas are also compared with the observed identical-config generation variability (report-only)

continuation_ppl_niah_passage_retrieval.rule: on the canonical subset, bf16 and rabit2 reproduce the canonical targets within the original Exp1 tolerances

hotpotqa_qasper.rule: on the canonical subset (hotpotqa first 20, qasper all 24), bf16 and rabit2 must pass the FROZEN post-failure per-example QA control gate against results/quality/<benchmark>.log (identical dataset indices, token counts and ground truths; score mismatches and L1 within the frozen maxima). Units beyond the canonical subset have no control reference

storage.rule: every unit's printed logical KV MB within 0.001 MB of the exact model: rabit2 = the accepted canonical accounting at prefix T; bf16 = 32*2*T*8*128*2 bytes; on the canonical subset also equal to the canonical per-unit values
storage.prefix: continuation 1024; NIAH context - 1; LongBench used tokens - 1

structure: bf16 and rabit2 summary rows present with the expected counts
per-unit bf16 / rabit2 rows complete, identical unit keys, in order
canonical subset units identical (keys / indices) to the canonical run

outputs.statistics: results/mlsys2027/variance/variance_results.json (schema: bootstrap spec; per benchmark: metric, delta_definition, n_units, bf16_aggregate, rabit2_aggregate, delta, ci_low, ci_high, confidence, resamples, seed, ci_contains_zero, robustness, per_unit)

compute_plan.gpu_runs: 5 Modal apps (one per benchmark), 2 methods each, sequential
compute_plan.offline: bootstrap and robustness analysis on CPU from the logs; no GPU re-run

completion_criterion: all five benchmarks valid; paired bootstrap 95% CI computed for every headline delta (bf16 vs rabit2), with overlap or non-overlap with zero explicitly reported
